Body.Content:
The Azure Sphere 19.02 release is available now. In this release, we focus on broader device capabilities, reducing your time to market through new reference solutions, and continuing to prioritize features based on feedback from organizations that build by using Azure Sphere. 

For information about all the features that are included in this release, see our blog post.
